title: Ok but not great.
text: Ok but not great.. I will probably end up returning this.  First, the cup gets so hot that it will burn your lip. I had it set on 170 degrees.  It is a bit cooler on the lips if you leave the lid off however this is a major flaw to me. Second, it gives teas a weird metallic taste. I beleive it heats better than a cheap more traditional mug warmer.  This is NOT made to heat liquid from a room temp/cold temp to hot. This is for keeping a hot liquid, hot.  Other reviews have mentioned a problem with on/off button.  I did not have this problem however the button is super sensitive. If I keep it, I will be sure to unplug it because I could see a cat stepping on it or something touching, or even brushing it, and it turning on.
